title: WashU Medicine and Barnes-Jewish Transplant Center perform breakthrough robotic liver-kidney transplant
summary_en: Adeel Khan, MD, a professor of surgery at WashU Medicine, and Jessica Lindemann, MD, PhD, an assistant professor of surgery, worked together to perform the combined surgery — the world’s first-reported robotic transplantation of both organs simultaneously.
title_cn: WashU Medicine and Barnes-Jewish Transplant Center perform breakthrough robotic liver-kidney transplant
